findings.title: Stage-2 reference set misses node-id columns not named *file_ref (record_people.photo_ref, record_owners.photo_ref, evidence_ref); web360.py:725 is combined_property_expenses, not land_expenses
findings.fix: Restrict to text columns and widen the catalog predicate to file_ref/photo_ref/evidence_ref plus %\_file\_ref and %\_photo\_ref (card_node_id stays excluded); use a raw string; add a record_people.photo_ref refused-and-kept test; correct the ~725 attribution.

findings.title: The key-isolation loop uses a non-existent $WEB_PID, omits university, and uses script-internal subshell PIDs whose exec-time environment is not the uvicorn/Vite environment
findings.fix: Select processes by listening port (8082, 8081, 5173, university port; never 8080) via lsof -tiTCP:<port> -sTCP:LISTEN, then run a count-only grep -c 'AADHAAR_ENC_KEY='; also run once with the key exported in the launching shell.

findings.title: _encrypt_bytes fernet branch calls _fernet() outside try; an invalid AADHAAR_ENC_KEY raises plain RuntimeError on resolver typed-record paths instead of ProtectionUnavailable
findings.fix: Move cipher = _fernet() inside the try so any exception goes through _unavailable(...); add a §12.1 test asserting PROTECTION_FAILED_MESSAGE and a cause=RuntimeError WARNING with no key material.
